newsitem.title: CANADA: Canada leading indicator rises 1.0 pct in Feb.
newsitem.headline: Canada leading indicator rises 1.0 pct in Feb.

text.p: The Canadian composite leading indicator rose 1.0 percent in February to 189.0 (base 1981) after a revised 1.0 percent (0.9 percent) rise in January, Statistics Canada said on Tuesday.

The indicator foreshadows economic activity by tabulating figures for sectors that rise or fall in advance of broader movements in the economy. The figure is "smoothed", reflecting a moving average of approximately the past five months.
The unsmoothed index, reflecting the past month only, rose 0.3 percent in the month to 192.6. A Reuter survey of economists had forecast that index would rise 0.8 percent.
